title: IUIC Los Angeles: Destruction Of Nicanor Approaches
cleanTitle: IUIC Los Angeles: Destruction Of Nicanor Approaches
segments: Victory faith and divine Justice this is
the story of the day of
Nicor in the 151st year almus a wicked
Israelite sought to be high priest of
Israel to achieve this he betrayed his
people and conspired with King Demetrius
of Greece Demetrius filled with hatred
for Israel sent his General nicanor a
ruthless Warrior to destroy Judas macbes
the fearless leader of Israel's
resistance nicanor arrogantly marched
into the Holy Temple threatening to
destroy it and build a temple to bakus a
pagan God he vowed to burn it to the
ground unless Judas was delivered to him
outnumbered but undeterred Judas and his
small army prayed to the most high for
strength they met nicanor massive Army
armed with elephants and Horsemen in
battle Against All Odds Israel triumphed
nicanor was slain and his army was
scattered Judas ordered nicanor head and
blasphemous hand once raised against the
temple to be displayed in Jerusalem as a
sign of the almighty's Justice the
people rejoiced praising the most high
for keeping his Temple undefiled the
13th of Adar was declared a day of
Celebration and Thanksgiving to this day
the day of nicanor reminds us of the
most High's power and faithfulness to
those who trust in him celebrate the
victory honor the Almighty
